description: Search historical newspaper pages in the Chronicling America corpus. Returns matching pages with OCR text excerpts (~500 characters), publication title, date, the states LOC indexes the title under, and the page URL needed for libofcongress_get_newspaper_page. Filters by keyword, date range, US state, and newspaper title. The OCR excerpts are sufficient for relevance assessment — call libofcongress_get_newspaper_page with the returned url field to read the full page text. OCR quality varies: 19th-century and degraded materials may contain fragmented or garbled text.

date_end.description: End year for date filter, inclusive (e.g., 1920). Omit for no upper bound.

date_start.description: Start year for date filter, inclusive (e.g., 1900). Omit for no lower bound.

newspaper_title.description: Filter to a specific newspaper by title (partial match accepted).

query.description: Keyword search across OCR text and newspaper metadata.

state.description: Filter to newspapers published in this US state. Use the full state name, lowercase (e.g., "oklahoma", "new york").

name: libofcongress_search_newspapers

effectiveQuery.description: The keyword query as submitted to the Chronicling America API, after trimming.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date_range`: date_start is later than date_end. `rate_limit_exceeded`: LOC API rate limit exceeded; requests are blocked for approximately 1 hour. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_next.description: True when a retrievable next page follows this one. Never promises a page past LOC's ~100,000-item retrieval ceiling.

items.description: Newspaper page results matching the search query and filters.
A single newspaper page search result.

description.description: OCR text excerpt (~500 chars) for relevance assessment.

states.description: Every US state LOC indexes this newspaper title under (e.g., ["georgia", "south carolina"]), in LOC order. A title indexed against its circulation area lists several, so no entry is necessarily the place of publication — libofcongress_get_newspaper_page returns place_of_publication. Absent when LOC lists no state.

url.description: LOC resource URL for this page — pass to libofcongress_get_newspaper_page to get full OCR text.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty or a page is out of range — echoes applied filters and suggests how to broaden. Absent on successful result pages.

pages.description: Total retrievable pages. For result sets larger than LOC will page through (~100,000 pages) this is capped, and a notice discloses how to reach the rest (partition by date/state).

total.description: Total number of matching newspaper pages in the result set.

totalCount.description: Total matching newspaper pages — mirrors output.total for agent reasoning.

title: Search Historical Newspapers
